title.ko: 부정어 도치: Never have I … · Not only … but also · Hardly … when
title.en: negative inversion: Never have I … · Not only … but also · Hardly … when

explain.ko: 도치는 문장의 앞에 놓인 부정어나 제한어를 강조하기 위해 조동사를 주어 앞으로 보내는 구조입니다. Never, rarely, hardly, no sooner, not only, only after, under no circumstances 등이 문두에 오면 조동사 + 주어 + 동사 순서가 됩니다(Never have I seen such a place). 조동사가 없으면 do/does/did를 사용합니다(Not only did she sing well). No sooner … than와 Hardly … when은 두 사건이 연달아 일어났음을 나타내며 앞 절은 과거완료(had + p.p.)입니다. 격식 있는 글이나 연설, 강한 감정을 표현할 때 어울립니다.
explain.en: Inversion puts an auxiliary verb before the subject after a negative or restrictive expression at the start of a sentence, for emphasis. After never, rarely, hardly, no sooner, not only, only after, under no circumstances, the order is auxiliary + subject + verb (Never have I seen such a place). If there is no auxiliary, use do/does/did (Not only did she sing well). No sooner … than and Hardly … when show two events following each other, with had + past participle in the first clause. Inversion suits formal writing, speeches and strong feelings.

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Form
예문 / Example
rows: Never have I felt so tired.
Not only + aux + subject … but also …
Not only did he win, but he also broke the record.
No sooner had + S + p.p. + than …
No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
Under no circumstances should you panic.

notes.ko: 도치는 평서문의 어순과 다르므로 의문문처럼 보이지만 의문문이 아닙니다.
notes.en: The word order looks like a question but the sentence is a statement.

notes.ko: No sooner 뒤에는 than을, Hardly 뒤에는 when(또는 before)을 씁니다.
notes.en: Use than after no sooner and when (or before) after hardly.

notes.ko: 일상 대화에서는 잘 쓰지 않고 에세이, 연설, 이야기에서 강조할 때 씁니다.
notes.en: It is rare in everyday talk; use it in essays, speeches and stories.

task.model: Never have I seen such an amazing concert. Not only did the singer sing well, but she also connected with the audience. No sooner had the show ended than everyone stood up and applauded. Under no circumstances will I forget that night.

model_trans.ko: 그렇게 놀라운 콘서트는 본 적이 없어요. 가수는 노래를 잘할 뿐만 아니라 관객과 소통도 잘했어요. 공연이 끝나자마자 모두가 일어나서 박수를 쳤어요. 어떤 경우에도 그 밤을 잊지 못할 거예요.
model_trans.en: Never have I seen such an amazing concert. Not only did the singer sing well, but she also connected with the audience. No sooner had the show ended than everyone stood up and applauded. Under no circumstances will I forget that night.
